style: Calm, precise, technical diagram on a transparent background. Cards, dashed connectors and one rose canary chip that keeps becoming copies. Matches the Remotion house set (docs/videos/*.webm).
font: Inter 400-800 + JetBrains Mono 400-700 (local woff2 in assets/fonts)

customize.note: Hand-authored diagram: the closest form category is kinetic-type (text callouts are the payload), but the motif is a chip copied along connectors, which no catalog block covers. Catalog searched for 'dashed connector line with a chip travelling along it' (no fit) and 'typewriter code line typing in' (code-typing is a full 1920x1080 code block; a 43-char line is a per-char reveal instead).

content.dominant_motif: One secret becoming copies you can't recall: the rose CANARY_ENV_7f3a9c chip is copied, never moved.

sources.tip: docs/setup/secrets-safety.mdx 'Why this matters' Tip: once in context it is on the wire to the model provider and saved in plain text in local session history; rotating the key is then the only fix.
sources.table: docs/setup/secrets-safety.mdx 'What Each Layer Does NOT Cover', last row: saved in plain text in ~/.claude/projects/ (all 6 runs with session saving on).
sources.warning: docs/setup/secrets-safety.mdx 'Plan type' Warning: Team, Enterprise and API keep data 30 days by default; Free, Pro and Max keep it 5 years if you allow your data to improve models, 30 days if you don't; local session files kept 30 days by default (cleanupPeriodDays).

scenes.text: Title 'Once it's in context, it's out' + subtitle. A .env card (PAYMENTS_API_KEY=CANARY_ENV_7f3a9c); a copy of the rose chip lifts out and lands in the indigo 'Claude's context' box.
scenes.motion: fade_in cards; chip lift (y -22) then arc into context slot, power3.out; context border pulses lavender on landing

scenes.text: Two copies leave at once. Right: dashed 'on the wire' line to 'Model provider'; retention tag 'Team / Enterprise / API: 30 days' and 'Free / Pro / Max: 30 days, or 5 years if shared for training'. Down: 'saved to disk' line to ~/.claude/projects/…/session.jsonl; a JSON line types in with the canary in rose; tag 'plain text · kept 30 days'.
scenes.motion: connectors draw (scaleX / scaleY); chip copies travel along them simultaneously; per-char typewriter; tag lines stagger 0.1s

scenes.text: Pattern interrupt: everything but the .env card dims to 0.3; the .env card turns mint, a rotate icon spins once, the key becomes 'rotated'. Takeaway 'Only fix: rotate the key.' (mint, 44px) + 'Prevention beats cleanup — block it before it's read.' Hold ≥ 2.8s with both copies still visible but dimmed.
scenes.motion: dim fade 0.5s power2.out; rotate icon 360° power2.inOut; chip swap; takeaway slide_bottom 16px power3.out
